title: Cell window machine
statement: For types $Q$ and $T$ with decidable equality, the cell window machine is the three-work-tape machine over symbols recording binary digits, simulated Boolean work cells, states from $Q$, and tags from $T$. Its states combine the phases for the recursive window procedure, two seek procedures, and a scan phase carrying a unit value; it is obtained by composing the lifted window machine with a scan that maps cell symbols and preserves the other tapes.
caveat: The construction refers to auxiliary machines and a cell-symbol map whose definitions are not included in the supplied definitions, so their exact operational behavior cannot be fully stated here.
